# Gayatri Flowers Suppliers™

Gayatri Flowers Suppliers™ is one of the leading wholesale bulk flower suppliers in Shirdi, Maharashtra, India, serving decorators, wedding planners, mandap contractors, temples, retailers, and event businesses since 2005.

The business is known for supplying fresh premium-quality flowers in bulk quantities with same-day dispatch across Maharashtra.

Core flower categories:
- Marigold / Zendu flowers
- Premium roses / gulab
- Shevanti / chrysanthemum
- Mogra jasmine
- Lotus flowers
- Garland flowers
- Temple flowers
- Event decoration flowers
